研究員坐在桌前操作顯微鏡，並未站在白板前書寫公式。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 考驗比較級結構（than）中，連綴動詞 is 後接形容詞比較級 more efficient。

items.prompt_en: The newly installed solar water heater is significantly ____ than the aging gas-powered unit it replaced.

evidence.quote_en: is significantly ____ than the aging gas-powered unit
evidence.reasoning_zh: be 動詞 is 後需用形容詞作主詞補語，且後方有比較連接詞 than 與修飾比較級的副詞 significantly，故須填形容詞比較級 more efficient。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考形容詞比較級與詞性判斷。空格位於連綴動詞 `is` 與程度副詞 `significantly`（顯著地）之後，作主詞 `solar water heater` 的補語，應使用形容詞；又因後方有比較標記 `than`（比……），故須選形容詞比較級 **(C) more efficient**（更具能源效率的）。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: efficient 為形容詞原級，無法與後方的比較連接詞 than 搭配。
efficiently 為副詞原級，既不可作 is 的主詞補語，也缺少比較級形式。
efficiency 為名詞（效率），不可直接受副詞 significantly 修飾並搭配 than。

vocabulary.example_en: The city plans to replace its aging water pipes over the next five years.

difficulty.rationale_zh: 考驗表排除例外條件之複合介系詞（aside from / except for）與其他介系詞之語意辨析。

items.prompt_en: The seasonal discount voucher may be redeemed at any Cortland Apparel store nationwide, ____ outlet locations and airport kiosks.

evidence.quote_en: at any Cortland Apparel store nationwide, ____ outlet locations and airport kiosks.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 前文說全國門市皆可兌換，逗號後列出暢貨中心與機場櫃位作為排除條件，故填 aside from（除……之外）。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考複合介系詞片語的語意與例外條件。前半句指出「季節折扣券可在全國任何一家 Cortland 服飾門市兌換」，逗號後接特定店型 `outlet locations and airport kiosks`（暢貨中心門市與機場小型櫃位），在商務條款中用以標明排除的例外門市，故選 **(A) aside from**（除……之外）。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: prior to 意為「在……之前（時間）」，後面應接時間或事件，無法接地點名詞表除外。
on behalf of 意為「代表（某人或某機構）」，語意不合折扣券使用限制。
by means of 意為「藉由……手段／方法」，與排除特定門市無關。

vocabulary.example_en: Vouchers can be redeemed online or in person.
Aside from a minor delay, the event went smoothly.

items.prompt_en: Following last week's security audit, the chief information officer recommended that every remote employee ____ the virtual private network software immediately.

evidence.quote_en: recommended that every remote employee ____ the virtual private network software
evidence.reasoning_zh: 建議動詞 recommended 後接 that 名詞子句時，子句動詞須省略 should 並使用原形動詞 update，不受單數主詞 every remote employee 影響。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考建議／要求動詞後的假設法語氣（Subjunctive Mood）。當主要子句動詞為表「建議、要求、堅持、命令」（如 `recommend, suggest, request, require, insist`）時，其後 `that` 子句中的動詞須為 `(should) + 原形動詞`。因此儘管子句主詞 `every remote employee` 為單數，仍須填入原形動詞 **(B) update**。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: updates 為第三人稱單數現在式，忽略了 recommended that 觸發的假設法原形動詞規則。
updating 為現在分詞，無法單獨作為 that 子句中的限定動詞。
to update 為不定詞，不可作 that 名詞子句的述語動詞。

vocabulary.example_en: An external firm conducts our annual security audit.

provenance.rights_note_zh: 本題組為本專案原創命題內容，未抄襲 ETS 官方試題、商業出版品或第三方付費題庫。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 結合時態、商務語境名詞、跨句轉折副詞與完整句插入題，需理解社區圖書館數位化館藏升級脈絡。

documents.title_en: Oakridge Public Library: Historical Newspaper Archive Upgrade

blocks.text_en: Beginning November 1, the Oakridge Public Library [[blank:ag-i-p6-000001-1]] its online historical newspaper archive to include regional periodicals dating back to 1890. Over the past eight months, our preservation team has scanned more than 40,000 pages of fragile microfilm so that residents can search local history records from home. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000001-2]] To use the new portal, patrons simply need to enter their fourteen-digit library card number on our website. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000001-3]], the third-floor microfilm reading room will close for two weeks starting November 4 while technicians install high-resolution viewing terminals. Patrons who require [[blank:ag-i-p6-000001-4]] locating specific municipal records during this closure may schedule an appointment with a reference librarian.

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase to fill in blank [[blank:ag-i-p6-000001-1]].

evidence.quote_en: Beginning November 1, the Oakridge Public Library [[blank:ag-i-p6-000001-1]] its online historical newspaper archive
evidence.reasoning_zh: 句首時間標記 Beginning November 1 與後文 will close starting November 4 皆預告即將生效的新措施，故用未來簡單式 will expand。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考篇章時態一致性。句首 `Beginning November 1`（自 11 月 1 日起）搭配後文 `will close for two weeks starting November 4` 顯示本公告發布於 11 月之前，預告即將推行的服務升級，且後接直接受詞 `its online historical newspaper archive`，故選未來簡單式 **(B) will expand**。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: expanded 為過去簡單式，與預告未來 11 月 1 日生效的公告語境不符。
had expanded 為過去完成式，需有過去基準點，不適用於預告未來新服務。
多出介系詞 from，導致後方無法直接接原受詞 its online historical newspaper archive to include...。

vocabulary.example_en: Back issues of trade periodicals are stored in the digital archive.

items.prompt_en: Select the best sentence to fill in blank [[blank:ag-i-p6-000001-2]].

choices.text_en: This remote access eliminates the need to visit the branch in person to view delicate paper copies.
Late fees for overdue hardcover books will increase by ten cents per day.
Several authors will sign copies of their new novels in the lobby tonight.
Unfortunately, the scanning project was canceled due to budget cuts.

evidence.quote_en: our preservation team has scanned more than 40,000 pages of fragile microfilm so that residents can search local history records from home. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000001-2]] To use the new portal, patrons simply need to enter their fourteen-digit library card number
evidence.reasoning_zh: 前句提到已掃描四萬頁微縮膠卷讓居民可從家中搜尋（search ... from home），選項 A 的 This remote access 精準指涉前句「從家中搜尋」，並銜接後句如何使用該新入口網站。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考完整句插入與代名詞指涉（Reference & Cohesion）。空格前一句說明團隊已掃描超過四萬頁脆弱的微縮膠卷，「讓居民能從家中檢索地方歷史紀錄（search local history records from home）」；空格後一句說明登入該新入口網站的方式。(A) 開頭的 `This remote access`（這項遠端存取服務）正好回指前句的 `from home`，並自然過渡到後句的網站登入步驟。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 談論精裝書逾期罰款調漲，偏離歷史報紙數位典藏主題。
談論今晚大廳的新書簽名會，與線上資料庫升級無關。
宣稱掃描計畫因預算刪減而取消，與前句「已完成四萬頁掃描」及後句「啟用新網站」完全矛盾。

vocabulary.example_en: Archival gloves must be worn when handling fragile documents.

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase to fill in blank [[blank:ag-i-p6-000001-3]].

evidence.quote_en: [[blank:ag-i-p6-000001-3]], the third-floor microfilm reading room will close for two weeks starting November 4 while technicians install high-resolution viewing terminals.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 前段說明線上檢索服務啟用，本句補充在相關升級期間三樓實體微縮膠卷閱覽室將暫時關閉兩週以安裝高解析終端機，用 In the meantime（在此期間／同時）銜接最自然。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考轉折與時序副詞片語。前文說明讀者可透過網站線上檢索數位典藏，本句則告知「在此同時／與此期間，三樓微縮膠卷閱覽室將自 11 月 4 日起關閉兩週以安裝新終端機」。**(B) In the meantime**（在此期間、與此同時）能妥善銜接同一升級計畫下的並行安排。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: For instance（舉例來說）用於舉例說明前句觀點，但實體閱覽室關閉並非輸入圖書證號的例子。
On the contrary（恰恰相反）用於否定前句陳述，不合文意。
As a result of 為複合介系詞，後方須接名詞片語而不可直接加逗號與完整子句。

vocabulary.example_en: Your replacement card will arrive in five days; in the meantime, use this temporary pass.

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase to fill in blank [[blank:ag-i-p6-000001-4]].

evidence.quote_en: Patrons who require [[blank:ag-i-p6-000001-4]] locating specific municipal records during this closure may schedule an appointment with a reference librarian.
evidence.reasoning_zh: require assistance (in) doing something 意為「需要協助尋找特定市政紀錄」，故可預約參考諮詢館員。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考語境名詞與固定搭配。句意為「在閱覽室關閉期間，需要______尋找特定市政紀錄的讀者，可預約參考諮詢館員」。`require assistance + V-ing`（需要協助做某事）與後文「預約諮詢館員」語意完全呼應，故選 **(A) assistance**（協助）。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: attendance 意為「出席、到場人數」，不符合請館員幫忙查找資料的語境。
allowance 意為「津貼、容許量」，與圖書館文獻檢索服務無關。
appliance 意為「家用電器」，為可數名詞且語意完全不符。

vocabulary.example_en: Ask the reference librarian for help with archival databases.

difficulty.rationale_zh: 物流中心導入光學分揀系統之內部備忘錄，考驗詞性、介系詞搭配、指涉代名詞與完整句插入之跨句邏輯。

documents.title_en: Memo: Trial Run of Optical Parcel Sorting System in Zone B

blocks.text_en:
To: All Distribution Center Supervisors
From: Marcus Vance, Director of Warehouse Operations

Starting next Monday, Zone B will begin a two-week operational trial of our new optical parcel sorting conveyor. The equipment is designed to process up to 3,500 packages per hour, [[blank:ag-i-p6-000002-1]] reducing manual scanning bottlenecks during peak evening shifts. During the initial phase, only standard rectangular cartons weighing under twenty kilograms will be routed through the automated lane. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000002-2]] Floor supervisors must ensure that all shift leads complete the safety checklist [[blank:ag-i-p6-000002-3]] activating the conveyor belts each morning. Any barcode recognition errors should be logged in the shared maintenance spreadsheet so our engineers can calibrate [[blank:ag-i-p6-000002-4]] before full deployment in December.

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase to fill in blank [[blank:ag-i-p6-000002-1]].

evidence.quote_en: process up to 3,500 packages per hour, [[blank:ag-i-p6-000002-1]] reducing manual scanning bottlenecks
evidence.reasoning_zh: 空格修飾現在分詞 reducing（減少人工掃描瓶頸），需用副詞 dramatically（大幅地）。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考分詞構句中的副詞修飾。逗號後 `____ reducing manual scanning bottlenecks` 為結果分詞構句，修飾分詞動詞 `reducing`（減少）必須使用副詞 **(B) dramatically**（大幅地、顯著地）。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: dramatic 為形容詞，只能修飾名詞，不可修飾動詞分詞 reducing。
dramatize 為原形動詞（使戲劇化），放入分詞片語前造成語法與語意錯誤。
drama 為名詞（戲劇），無法修飾分詞 reducing。

vocabulary.example_en: Automated scanners helped eliminate bottlenecks at the loading dock.

items.prompt_en: Select the best sentence to fill in blank [[blank:ag-i-p6-000002-2]].

choices.text_en: Irregularly shaped parcels and heavy crates should continue to be handled at the manual stations in Zone A.
All warehouse employees must submit their vacation requests to human resources by Friday.
The optical sorting system was decommissioned after ten years of reliable service.
Customers can track their international air freight using the mobile application.

evidence.quote_en: During the initial phase, only standard rectangular cartons weighing under twenty kilograms will be routed through the automated lane. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000002-2]]
evidence.reasoning_zh: 前句限定初期僅「20公斤以下的標準長方體紙箱」走自動分揀道，選項 A 緊接著說明「形狀不規則包裹與重型木箱應繼續由 A 區人工工作站處理」，條件互補完整。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考完整句插入與條件互補邏輯。空格前句指出：「在初期階段，只有 20 公斤以下的標準矩形紙箱會導入自動分揀線」。讀者自然會問：那不符合此規格的包裹怎麼辦？**(A)** 明確補充「形狀不規則的包裹與重型貨箱，應繼續在 A 區的人工工作站處理」，與前句構成嚴密的作業分流說明。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 談論向人資部提交休假申請，偏離包裹分揀作業主題。
宣稱光學分揀系統在服役十年後除役，與首句「下週一啟動新系統試運轉」矛盾。
談論顧客用手機 App 追蹤國際空運，不屬於針對倉儲主管的內部設備操作備忘錄內容。

vocabulary.example_en: Irregularly shaped items require special packaging materials.

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase to fill in blank [[blank:ag-i-p6-000002-3]].

evidence.quote_en: complete the safety checklist [[blank:ag-i-p6-000002-3]] activating the conveyor belts each morning.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 安全檢查表必須在每天早上啟動輸送帶「之前（prior to + V-ing）」完成。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考介系詞片語與作業時序。句意為「現場主管必須確保所有班組長在每天早上啟動輸送帶______完成安全檢查表」。依安全規範，檢查必須在啟動設備之前完成，且空格後為動名詞 `activating`，故選複合介系詞 **(A) prior to**（在……之前）。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: except for（除……之外）放入後語意變成「除了啟動輸送帶之外要完成安全表」，不合時序。
on account of（由於、因為）表因果關係，不符合啟動前完成安檢的程序要求。
in addition 為副詞片語，後面必須加上 to（in addition to）才能接動名詞 activating。

vocabulary.example_en: Press the green button to activate the emergency ventilation system.

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase to fill in blank [[blank:ag-i-p6-000002-4]].

evidence.quote_en: Any barcode recognition errors should be logged in the shared maintenance spreadsheet so our engineers can calibrate [[blank:ag-i-p6-000002-4]] before full deployment in December.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 前文提及 optical parcel sorting conveyor 與 barcode recognition errors，工程師需要校準（calibrate）的對象即為負責辨識條碼的「感應器（the sensors）」，且代名詞選項與複數主詞 engineers 皆無法合理配對。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考篇章指涉與語境搭配。前半句提到「任何條碼辨識錯誤都應記錄在共用維修試算表中，以便我們的工程師在十二月全面部署前校準______」。若選反身代名詞 `itself` 與複數主詞 `engineers` 不一致，選 `theirs` 指涉不明；而 **(C) the sensors**（感應器）具體指明光學條碼分揀設備中需校準的元件，語意與文法皆最精準。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: theirs 為所有格代名詞（他們的東西），前文並無對應的所屬名詞可指涉。
itself 為單數反身代名詞，與該子句複數主詞 our engineers 在文法上不相容。
each other（彼此）若作 calibrate 的受詞，會變成「工程師互相校準對方」，語意荒謬。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 全面部署；正式全面上線
vocabulary.example_en: Software bugs must be resolved prior to full deployment.
